A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the case-cohort design is a good alternative to random sampling for estimating the regression parameter in a Cox model with a large sample size and a small number of events.

the maximum pseudoliklihood and related estimators are asymptotically efficient in the sense that they achieve the asymptotic lower bound for estimating a finite-dimensional parameter, provided that the effective sample size is large.
